title: Small retrieval-evaluation fixture
text: A deterministic evaluation fixture for comparing ranked retrieval results at k=5. It contains three queries, their total relevant-document counts, and the number of relevant documents present in the top five. Precision@5 is relevant retrieved divided by five. Recall is relevant retrieved divided by all relevant documents. The per-query attainable precision ceiling is min(total relevant, 5) divided by five.

title: Ranking metric definitions
text: Precision@k is the fraction of the top k retrieved items that are relevant. Recall@k is the fraction of all relevant items retrieved in the top k. Macro averages assign equal weight to each query. A normalized precision score can be defined as macro precision divided by the mean per-query attainable precision ceiling.

title: Orchestration design notes
text: A supervisor routes work to focused specialists, checks evidence provenance and result completeness, and terminates after a bounded number of transitions. Specialist output should carry source identifiers so the final response can be validated.
